description: This file defines a Java class 'PersistableCustomerAttribute' that extends 'CustomerAttributeEntity' and manages customer option and value associations.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerAttribute
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable customer attribute, including associations with customer options and option values.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue

methods.name: getCustomerOption
